reason: A provider-neutral agent memory plugin that recalls durable context before model turns and reflects completed sessions into structured local memory, with workspace import, CLI hooks, and an optional web panel.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供本地持久记忆，在模型响应前召回相关上下文，并在会话结束后整理保存新的结构化记忆。
summaries.en: Provides local persistent memory for agents by recalling relevant context before model turns and structuring new memories after completed sessions.

capabilities: recalls stored memory into agent prompts
distills completed sessions into structured memory using a configured model
stores memory in a local SQLite database
reads and imports workspace instruction and skill files
runs through Claude Code and Codex hooks
provides a web settings panel for memory management
modifies user hook configuration when installed via the provided installer
